{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}")

# Confirm they are not completed (they should be excluded)
print(f"Test orders with status 'completed': {len(test_orders[test_orders['status'] == 'completed'])}")

# Filter: only completed orders, exclude test orders
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
